name: odoo-connector
description: Odoo Connector for Claude Code: the connector itself, and a profiles pane.

plugins.name: odoo-connector
plugins.description: Query and edit Odoo through its built-in JSON-RPC API, in every Claude Code session. Needs Node.js 18+.

plugins.name: odoo-profiles
plugins.description: Manage Odoo Connector profiles in a pane and show which profile each Odoo tool call uses.
